title: Statistics dashboard counts withdrawn applications as rejected

articles.subject: Statistics dashboard counts withdrawn applications as rejected
articles.body:
Hello,

Our approval rate in the dashboard is 4 percentage points lower than what we report to the ministry. The difference is the withdrawn applications, which the dashboard counts in the rejected bucket.

This number is published, so it needs to be right.

Best regards,
Håkan Nyberg

articles.subject: Re: Statistics dashboard counts withdrawn applications as rejected
articles.body:
Hello,

Confirmed. The dashboard groups everything that is not approved as rejected, which is wrong for withdrawn and for expired. We are separating the three.

The underlying data is correct, so once the grouping is fixed your historical figures will change to match what you report, without any data correction.

Regards,
Jonas Frid

articles.subject: Re: Statistics dashboard counts withdrawn applications as rejected
articles.body:
Numbers now match our own. Thank you.

Håkan
